title: Bhatura (Puffed Fried Bread)
summary: A yoghurt-raised dough rolled into rounds and deep-fried until it balloons.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, bicarbonate and salt, add the yoghurt and oil and enough water to make a soft dough; knead 5 min until smooth.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Divide into 8 balls and roll each into a 15 cm round about 3 mm thick, keeping them covered.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat the oil to 195 °C and fry one at a time, pressing gently with the slotted spoon so it balloons, 30-40 s each side until puffed and pale golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drain on paper and serve hot, with chickpea curry (chole), sliced onion and lemon.

tips: Keep the oil at 195 °C so the breads puff quickly.
Roll evenly; thin patches stop the bread puffing.
storage: Best eaten immediately. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
